articles.title: Nytt stålbad på Ebay – stor personalnedskärning
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Nytt stålbad på Ebay – stor personalnedskärning
articles.body_text: Ebay nobbar budet från Gamestop. Arkivbild. Nytt stålbad på Ebay – stor personalnedskärning Den amerikanska auktionssajten Ebay kommer att göra sig av med omkring 1 100 anställda, motsvarande 9 procent av personalstyrkan, rapporterar nyhetsbyrån Reuters . En talesperson på Ebay har bekräftat planerna, som innebär att auktionssajten väljer att fokusera på sina mest lönsamma enheter. Neddragningen är den andra bara i år på Ebay. I februari sade företaget att 800 arbetstillfällen skulle bort från organisationen, vilket då utgjorde 6 procent av personalstyrkan. Ebay köpte tidigare i år marknadsplatsen Depop och utmanas numera av Vinted, en litauisk auktionsplats på nätet, på den stora amerikanska marknaden. Beskedet om den nya neddragningen kommer inför en delårsrapport för tredje kvartalet, som väntas nästa vecka.

articles.title: Ny ordförande i Thule på plats
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Ny ordförande i Thule på plats
articles.body_text: Thule har fått en ny ordförande. Arkivbild Thules styrelse har på ett konstituerande möte utsett Per-Arne Blomqvist till ny styrelseordförande, skriver takboxtillverkaren i ett pressmeddelande. Beslutet ligger i linje med en begäran från bolagets största aktieägare. Det konstituerande mötet hölls sedan storägarna AMF, Handelsbanken Fonder och Alecta på onsdagen återkallat en begäran om extra bolagsstämma för val av styrelse och styrelseordförande. Begäran om extrastämman återkallades sedan Hans Eckerström, med 20 år i styrelsen, avgått som ordförande. ”Styrelsen står helt enig bakom bolagets strategiska inriktning och har fullt förtroende för vd och ledningsgrupp. Tillsammans ska vi fortsätta driva Thules utveckling och skapa långsiktigt värde för våra aktieägare”, säger Blomqvist i pressmeddelandet. Thules aktie sjunker 1,2 procent efter beskedet, vilket innebär minus 18 procent sedan årsskiftet.

articles.title: EU granskar Booking.com
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: EU granskar Booking.com
articles.body_text: Booking har missbrukat sin marknadsposition enligt spanska myndigheter. Arkivbild. EU-kommissionen granskar om hotellbokningssajten Booking.com bryter mot EU:s digitala tjänstelag, DSA. ”Européerna måste kunna boka sina semestrar utan rädsla för att bli bedragna”, skriver EU-kommissionären Henna Virkkunen i ett pressmeddelande . Enligt nyhetsbyrån AFP utlovar Booking.com fullt samarbete och bedyrar att säkerhet och skydd av personlig information är ”högsta prioritet”.

articles.title: AT&T-aktien faller trots höjd prognos
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: AT&T-aktien faller trots höjd prognos
articles.body_text: Kvartalsrapport från mobilbjässen AT&T. Arkivbild Aktien i den amerikanska mobiloperatören AT&T faller drygt 4 procent i terminshandeln på Wall Street. Detta trots att bolaget höjt vinstprognosen för helåret efter oväntat stor omsättning och hög vinst i tredje kvartalet. Antalet nya abonnenter, netto, hamnade något lägre än väntat på 379 000. Det kan jämföras med en snittprognos bland analytiker på 387 410 nya abonnenter, enligt Bloomberg. Omsättningen under kvartalet ökade till 32,3 miljarder dollar, en ökning med 5,3 procent jämfört med motsvarande kvartal i fjol. Snittprognosen bland analytiker låg på 31,7 miljarder dollar, enligt Bloomberg. Vinsten per aktie blev 65 cent, mot väntade 60 cent. För helåret räknar AT&T – vars aktie hittills i år har backat nästan 6 procent – nu med en vinst på 2,40 dollar per aktie.

articles.title: Fransk räntechock – värsta läget på 24 år
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Fransk räntechock – värsta läget på 24 år
articles.body_text: Frankrike präglas just nu av stor skadegörelse och plundring i samband med protester. Arkivbild Fransk räntechock – värsta läget på 24 år Riskpremierna på franska räntor stiger kraftigt efter helgens kravaller. Räntan på en tioårig fransk statsobligation var för första gången sedan 2002 över 5 procent på onsdagsförmiddagen. Gapet till tyska tioårsräntor har därmed vuxit till drygt 1,50 procentenheter. Det är det största gapet sedan eurokrisen och kan beskrivas som den riskpremie långivare kräver då de ser en risk för franska betalningsproblem. Protesterna i Frankrike – från början mot skolsystemet, dyra bostäder och höga priser – urartade i våldsamma kravaller, vandalism och plundring i många franska städer i helgen. Det har lett till utegångsförbud i delar av landet. Men till på lördag har nya protester aviserats. De våldsamma gatuscenerna utspelar sig samtidigt som det franska parlamentet förhandlar om en budget för 2027, där regeringens förslag är kraftiga åtstramningar för att få ned Frankrikes stora budgetunderskott.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

Reportageserie om valets vinnare och förlorare. Mer om programmet Publicerades: Mån 12 okt 02:00 Mån 12 okt • 3 min 42 sek Succé i riksdagsvalet men flopp lokalt. articles.title: Kulturnyheterna special: Avgörs valet på TikTok?
articles.summary: För första gången finns alla partiledare på Tiktok, samtidigt som nästan hälften av alla förstagångsväljare säger att de oftare tar del av politik på sociala medier än i tidningar, radio och tv. Vad gör det här med politiken, och är det på en kinesisk plattform som framställs som en säkerhetsrisk som det svenska valet kommer att avgöras? Medverkande: Emanuel Karlsten, journalist, Kajsa Falasca, forskare, och Oscar Samuelsson, kommunikationsrådgivare. Programledare: Cecilia Tiberg.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots for political gain
articles.summary: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.
articles.body_text: French President Emmanuel Macron has accused foreign leaders of exploiting the riots which erupted across the country on Saturday for electoral purposes. Without naming them, he said they were campaigning for forthcoming elections "at France's expense" with their comments on the violence, which erupted on the fringe of cost-of-living protests. Speaking on a visit to the Middle East, he referred to them as "leaders who are in campaign mode, whether here in the region or on the other side of the Atlantic". It was an apparent swipe at Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces parliamentary elections next week, and US President Donald Trump, for whom mid-term polls fall next month. Macron said the unnamed leaders had been influenced by fake videos generated by AI about the riots. Nearly 150 people have been jailed and more than 800 brought before the courts since the riots which gripped Paris and other cities including Lyon, Marseille and Nice. Video of running battles between masked rioters and police, as well as property being destroyed and stores being looted, spread across social media. The government admitted the police had "lost control" during the violence, which came after weeks of protests by students over conditions in high schools. Macron vowed afterwards that the authorities would be "uncompromising" towards "agitators from ultra-left fringe groups", which he blamed for much of the trouble. Speaking in the Qatari capital Doha, the French president said: "For me, there is no visible foreign interference in the events that took place. On the other hand, there was foreign manipulation of information afterwards, yes, and that gave rise to unacceptable and stupid comments from many people, including foreign leaders... "We had people claiming that we had been invaded by hordes of migrants and Islamists, which is completely false." On Tuesday, Netanyahu said in an interview for Israel's i24 channel that France, which has Western Europe's largest Muslim minority, had been hit by an "invasion of extremist Islam".

articles.title: US citizen Stephen Hubbard freed by Russia as Trump envoy meets Putin
articles.summary: The 74-year-old former teacher, who was captured, has been released without any "swap" required, Trump says.
articles.body_text: Russia has released a 74-year-old American citizen who was jailed for allegedly fighting on behalf of Ukraine, as President Vladimir Putin met US envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg for talks. Stephen Hubbard has been taken to the city's Pulkovo Airport, Putin said during the meeting early on Wednesday. President Donald Trump later said the former teacher was "on his way back home" and "there was no 'swap' necessary". Hubbard was sentenced to almost seven years in a penal colony in 2024. He was accused of serving in a defence unit in Izyum, eastern Ukraine, when he was captured by Russian forces shortly after Moscow's full-scale invasion in 2022. Writing on social media after Russian state media reported the release, Trump said it had followed a request he "made directly" to Putin last week. Some other releases of detained Americans from Russia have been obtained through prisoner swaps. Trump also appeared to defend his recent decision to suspend sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to come into force , writing that "if sanctions would have been placed", negotiations for Hubbard's release "would have come to a complete and total halt". The US state department had previously classified Hubbard, from Michigan, as "wrongfully detained" and the US president had suggested on Tuesday that his release may be imminent. "Watch what happens," Trump told reporters, "we have been focused ⁠on ​Hubbard". CBS News, the BBC's US media partner, reported that Hubbard had been in poor health and was expected to be flown to Texas for treatment. Witkoff praised Putin for releasing Hubbard: "You talk so much about my president, President Trump, being a humanitarian - you are a humanitarian also sir, and I salute that. I commend you." Hubbard was later seen thanking Witkoff as they met separately. Putin's financial adviser Kirill Dmitriev was also present.

articles.title: The Gambia to pay Yahya Jammeh victims from the proceeds of the ex-president's seized US mansion
articles.summary: The Gambia has confirmed receiving $2.5m from the sale of the house in Maryland.
articles.body_text: The Gambia will use funds received from the US from the forfeiture of long-time ruler Yahya Jammeh's property to pay victims of his rule, authorities have said. The Gambia's Reparations Commission said it received $2.5m (£1.86m) from the sale of a mansion in Maryland owned by former leader of the West African nation. The US had in 2022 secured the right to sell the property on grounds that it was acquired through "criminal proceeds and misappropriated Gambian public funds". Jammeh ruled The Gambia for more than 20 years after taking over in a coup in 1994 - a time marked by allegations of human rights abuses forced disappearances and extrajudicial killings. On Tuesday, the Gambia Reparations Commission said it was "pleased to inform victims, survivors and the public that it has received a total of $2,573,414.10" from the sale of Jammeh's property. It said it was committed to ensuring the funds were managed responsibly and transparently, "with due regard to the rights and needs of victims and survivors". Jammeh lost to Adama Barrow in the election of 2016, first accepting defeat and then rejecting the results. He eventually stepped down in 2017 amid intense regional and international pressure. Troops from several West African nations, including Senegal, had been deployed to The Gambia, threatening to drive Jammeh out of office. In the end he agreed to step down and went into exile Equatorial Guinea. A national commission then discovered that the former president had 281 properties in The Gambia, as well as the one in the US and one in Morocco, and controlled more than 100 bank accounts. There was no way that he could have afforded this on his salary and it concluded that he had misappropriated more than $300m.

articles.title: Helen Haines: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
articles.summary: Her alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and appeared in court for the first time on Wednesday.
articles.body_text: Helen Haines, the Australian MP who was hit by a car in what authorities say was a deliberate attack, has lost both her legs, her husband has confirmed. Phil Haines said the "horrendous incident" caused his wife significant injuries but "her heart and her mind are in good shape". He added that the "good news in all this is that she's alive". The alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and appeared in court for the first time on Wednesday. Nugent was arrested moments after he allegedly drove his Toyota LandCruiser into the independent MP outside her electorate office in the regional town of Wangaratta, about 240km (150miles) northeast of Melbourne. Haines' "road to recovery will be long and difficult, but we know she is a fighter," her husband said at a press conference in Melbourne where she is being treated. "She is a determined person who will do her best, with our support and love, to recover. And that is what we hope for." He thanked hospital staff and people, both in Australia and internationally, who have shown their concern for Haines, and urged those who want to show their support to donate to the Save the Children fund. "Please keep sending Helen your love," he added. Earlier on Wednesday, Nugent appeared at the local court to face three charges: dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally causing serious injury, and causing harm to a Commonwealth public official. Police said more charges may be laid, including attempted murder. Nugent - a local from the nearby town of Tarrawingee and known as an environmental campaigner - remained silent and emotionless during his brief court appearance. He did not apply for bail and is due back in court in February. Court documents show he was also charged with cultivating and possessing cannabis. In court, Nugent's lawyer said that his client had "mental health concerns" but did not give any further detail.

articles.title: Pakistan arrests man wanted by US over $126m postage fraud case
articles.summary: Faheem Akram allegedly sold more than 5 million fake postage labels for a fixed price of $2 a piece.
articles.body_text: Pakistan's cybercrime agency has arrested a man accused of running a counterfeit operation that caused $126 million (£94m) in losses to the US Postal service. Faheem Akram is accused of having sold fake stamps via a fraudulent website in the US since 2023. He was indicted by a federal grand jury in Florida last month for selling more than five million counterfeit shipping labels to thousands of US customers over the years. Authorities have now shut down the website. Earlier this month, the US Postal Inspection Service offered a reward of up to $100,000 for information leading to his arrest. According to the US Attorney's Office for the Southern District of Florida, the 33-year-old from Khanewal, Pakistan, operated LabelsBank.com. US prosecutors alleged that he sold counterfeit US postage at a fixed rate regardless of a package's weight, size or destination. The counterfeit labels, usually sold at $2 each, allegedly allowed customers to ship packages at rates far below legitimate prices, resulting in substantial lost revenue and shipping costs to the Postal Service. An investigation found that more than 5,200 individuals purchased more than 5.1 million counterfeit shipping labels, the office said in a press release. Akram is charged with one count of conspiracy to defraud the United States and to make and sell counterfeit postage stamps, five counts of making and selling counterfeit postage stamp labels, and four counts of wire fraud. If convicted, he faces a maximum penalty of five years in prison on the conspiracy and counterfeit postage counts, and 20 years in prison on each wire fraud count, the office said.

articles.title: Brian Stack: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
articles.summary: Brian Stack was crossing a street in Dublin in 1983 when he was shot in the back of the neck and died 18 months later.
articles.body_text: The family of a senior Irish prison officer murdered by the IRA has received a state apology on Wednesday for failings in investigations into his killing. Brian Stack, a father of three, was crossing a street in Dublin, after leaving a boxing match in 1983, when he was shot in the back of the neck. Stack, who was the chief prison officer at the high-security Portlaoise Prison, was left paralysed and died 18 months later, aged 49. There were three separate garda (Irish police) investigations into Stack's death, but no-one was brought to justice for his killing. The Taoiseach (Irish Prime Minister) Micheál Martin offered an apology on behalf of the state during a sitting of the Dáil (Irish parliament). Stack's wife Sheila and her sons Austin, Kieran and Oliver were in the chamber for the apology. Martin said the Provisional IRA is "still in the possession of all the facts" on this case. Speaking to BBC Radio Ulster's Good Morning Ulster programme Brian Stack's son, Austin Stack, said the apology "means an awful lot to us". "It's a great sense of comfort, to particularly my mother and to myself and my two brothers, because the state is officially owning up to the errors and the missions that happened," he said. He went on to say that the serious crime review team looked into the first investigation and "they found 194 errors and omissions". "So I have, and my family have, met with several ministers for justice down through the years and we have a requested sight of that report. "And every time we've requested it, we've been told that it's an internally valid document and that we cannot see it."

articles.title: Tesla and SpaceX: Why does Elon Musk want to merge the companies?
articles.summary: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.
articles.body_text: Elon Musk has spent years building Tesla and SpaceX into a pair of trillion-dollar technology empires. Now, he is considering bringing them together . Asked on Tuesday whether a merger would be a good idea, Musk was clear: "Yes." The prospect is more than hypothetical. Musk said special committees have been formed to assess a potential deal, although he stressed that there is no guarantee a merger will happen and that nothing has been agreed. With Tesla valued at roughly $1.5 trillion (£1.1 trillion) and SpaceX at $2 trillion, a combination of the two companies would mark the largest merger ever. Any deal would also need shareholder backing. But Musk said he saw "a lot to be gained" in bringing the businesses together. "In my opinion, 100%. It's just a question of when," says David Nicholson, chief technology advisor at market research firm The Futurum Group. The unveiling of the Tesla Roadster last week - a futuristic electric car powered by SpaceX rocket thrusters - served as a "symbolic embodiment" hinting at the two Musk companies merging, Nicholson said. Musk, chief executive of both SpaceX and Tesla, said bringing the firms together would be beneficial given the work each does around chips, artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology projects. Specifically, the deal would combine Tesla's cars, robots and self-driving technology with SpaceX's rockets, data centres, satellites and telecommunications operations. The move could be a step towards Musk's mission to build a self-sustaining city on Mars - a vision that has invited sceptics but also plenty of backers. Over the past year, Musk has moved to consolidate his businesses, with SpaceX acquiring xAI and X, formerly Twitter, before going public this year. But the merger would ultimately be decided by shareholders, with half of Tesla's needed to back the deal, a threshold even Musk described as "quite a high hurdle".

articles.title: France is divided over who to blame for weekend riots
articles.summary: In France and beyond there is widespread disagreement over what led to some of the worst unrest seen in French cities in modern history.
articles.body_text: "This is not the face of France! You media all focus on the violence and destruction of Saturday's protests. But that's not the majority. It's not 'us'. That's not France!" Elisabeth was speaking to me in front of a row of smashed shop windows, shattered glass still littering the tree-lined Parisian street. Its walls were daubed with red-lettered graffiti insulting French police and signed with the date of the riots, 17 October. I'd stopped Elisabeth and her friend to ask their thoughts on what happened on Saturday. Elisabeth was so upset that, when she spoke, she seemed close to tears. "My friend thinks this is civil war in France but I don't. Saturday is about something else entirely." But what did happen exactly? Who was behind the riots? While much of the looting seemed opportunistic, the violence looked pre-planned. Why orchestrate it now, after weeks of student protests? And who most stands to gain from the destruction this weekend? Elisabeth wasn't entirely sure. Different theories are doing the rounds - in and outside France. Black and white answers may be appealing, but the truth is there are many factors at play. The president of the National Assembly, Yaël Braun-Pivet, has proposed a parliamentary inquiry into the riots and how they were organised. French intelligence had briefed government circles earlier this month that left-wing anarchist groups were involved in the student protests. Their signature: a capital A, circled in black, was spray-painted on many buildings across France this weekend. French media have played and replayed a video shot on Saturday showing groups of young men dressed in black, with a black, folded kerchief around their face to hide their identity, apparently attacking a number of police vans with what look like large hammers or machetes. A French intelligence report dated 29 September, published by Le Figaro newspaper, details the "manipulation" of student demonstrations by student unions and political movements aligned with the radical left. It suggests the far-left political movement La France Insoumise (LFI) was relying on violence as an electoral strategy ahead of the 2027 presidential elections. LFI denies this. The mass looting of what is said to be over 3,000 shops and businesses on Saturday appears to have been largely opportunistic, according to French reports. Many youngsters immediately went online trying to sell their stolen wares, including designer trainers. Some didn't bother to cover their faces. Did they feel a sense of impunity?

articles.title: Alberta's decision to stay in Canada gives Carney backing to take on Trump
articles.summary: The overwhelming vote by Alberta to stay in Canada gives Mark Carney political capital to focus on remaking the country's economy, writes the BBC's Lyse Doucet.
articles.body_text: "Vote like Canada depends on it," Prime Minister Mark Carney declared to cheering crowds in Calgary last week on a stage emblazoned with bright red and white "Forever Canadian" banners. It's a message that appears to have struck a chord with the electorate, as preliminary results show more than two-thirds of Alberta voters said they want to remain a part of Canada. But the future of the federation does still rest on its richest province. Alberta, with most of Canada's proven oil reserves and abundant gas and mineral wealth, is playing a pivotal role in Ottawa's drive to survive a punishing trade war with the US by diversifying trade, strengthening its economy, and forging new alliances on the other side of the world. Carney, the former central banker who grew up in Alberta, is now Canada's builder-in-chief – at home, and beyond its borders. Note the emphasis in his first statement after Monday's vote on separation in the province, as soon as the scale of the victory was clear: "They chose unity, to build together, and to take care of each other." Albertans' overwhelming "yes" to stay in Canada gives him political bricks and mortar, too. "Don't mess with Canada," warned Thomas Lukaszuk, a former lawmaker whose Forever Canadian campaign played a key role in this referendum's outcome. Addressing elated supporters in Edmonton, the provincial capital, as the "yes" count for Canada kept tumbling in, Lukaszuk underlined that this vote "will send a very strong message to the rest of the world". Everyone knows he's talking about the troublesome neighbour to the south – in particular its president, who keeps threatening to turn Canada into the 51st US state. The same day Albertans were voting on their future in Canada, Trump sent his own signal north at a rally in Kansas ahead of next month's US midterm polls. "I will let you keep ice hockey, and I will let you keep your 'O Canada' national anthem," he promised before adding: "We're only kidding."

articles.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
articles.summary: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.
articles.body_text: Elon Musk has said he is actively considering merging Tesla and SpaceX, his two biggest companies. "Do I think it would be a good idea? Yes," Musk said during a call with financial analysts to discuss SpaceX's latest results on Tuesday. While Musk noted it could not be assumed a merger will go ahead, and it would need shareholders' support, he said special committees within both companies had been formed to examine the move. "The special committees have not reached agreement on terms of any transaction and there's no guarantee that they will," he said. "But I do think there is a lot of merit to merging and a lot to be gained." With Tesla valued at roughly $1.5 trillion (£1.1 trillion) and SpaceX at $2 trillion, a combination of the two companies would mark one of the largest mergers in history. SpaceX builds space rockets as well as Starlink internet satellites and provides a secured satellite network for governments, including the US, through its Starshield business. That part of the business is currently facing scrutiny over claims Ukraine's access to the network has been limited, leaving it vulnerable to deadly strikes by Russia. US President Donald Trump has denied either he or Musk ordered the slowdown . Musk himself suggested the US government might have been behind the restrictions. Starlink's total revenue rose to $5.2bn in the three months to 30 September from $3bn in the same period last year. It is dwarfed by SpaceX's expansion into offering cloud compute capacity for other tech companies, such as Anthropic and Google. The business generated revenues of $7.5bn over the three months, up from $813m last year. Musk, who became the world's first paper trillionaire after the SpaceX stock market debut earlier this year, said he is not included in either of the special committees considering the mega-merger. He described himself as a "conflicted party" as the chief executive of both Tesla and SpaceX.

articles.title: Trump and Zelensky at loggerheads despite Oslo optimism
articles.summary: The Ukrainian leader's hug with Steve Witkoff in the Norwegian capital is unlikely to dispel misgivings about US policy towards his country, writes Paul Adams.
articles.body_text: The hug that Trump envoy Steve Witkoff offered Volodymyr Zelensky before talks in Oslo is unlikely to have dispelled the Ukrainian leader's misgivings about the current direction of US policy towards his war-ravaged country. Zelensky posted a video of the moment on social media, with the message "Ukraine is working for peace. I thank our partners for their support!" But given everything that's happened this month, does the Ukrainian leader still regard Donald Trump as a partner? The two men have never been close – that much is obvious – but have they now fallen out once and for all? Both in rhetoric and actions, the past 10 days have seen evidence of a rupture as deep as any in their fractious relationship. Just listen to the way they talk about each other. "Zelensky's not a good guy for us to deal with," Trump told Newsmax last week. The verbal assault has continued this week. "Zelensky doesn't know what he's talking about," Trump told a reporter on Monday when asked what he thought of the Ukrainian leader's suggestion that striking a diesel deal with Russia put the US on the wrong side of history. Such personal attacks are typical of Trump's sledgehammer approach to diplomacy. It's hard to know when to take them seriously. In June, he lashed out at Israel's prime minister, using an expletive while criticising Benjamin Netanyahu's judgement. Four months later, he endorsed Netanyahu enthusiastically, calling him a "great warrior prime minister". "Trump can always do another U-turn," says Ian Bond of the Centre for European Reform. "But this does look bad."

articles.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa
articles.summary: The female patient, who sources have told the BBC is not Nigerian, is in isolation and in an Abuja hospital.
articles.body_text: Nigeria has recorded a case of Ebola in a female patient who travelled from Uganda in East Africa to Abuja, capital of the West African state. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said the diagnosis had been confirmed by laboratory tests. The patient, who health sources have told the BBC is not Nigerian and is the wife of a diplomat, is in isolation and receiving medical care after being admitted to a hospital in Abuja. She developed symptoms on Wednesday 7 October, four days after arriving in the country, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). Health authorities have begun contact-tracing to prevent further spread, with 44 close contacts of the woman identified. Nigeria, the first West African state to report a case linked to the current Ebola crisis in East Africa, successfully stopped a previous outbreak in 2014. Uganda's Ministry of Health has stressed there are currently no confirmed active Ebola cases in the country. "We urge the public to remain calm, vigilant and to practice regular handwashing and sanitising," it said. Ebola is a rare but deadly disease caused by a virus. As the disease progresses, vomiting and diarrhoea develop and it can lead to organ failure. Some, but not all, patients develop internal and external bleeding. The disease spreads from one person to another by contact with infected bodily fluids such as blood or vomit. The outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo, which began in May, has claimed at least 4,600 lives, with more than 9,500 cases recorded, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control reports . It was caused by the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, which is relatively rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way.

articles.title: Orient beach attack: South African swimmer killed by shark
articles.summary: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was out on her daily morning swim with her club when she was attacked, her family tell the BBC.
articles.body_text: A South African woman has been killed in a shark attack off the country's east coast, in what is the first recorded such fatality this year. Janine Lochrenberg was swimming off a beach in KuGompo City (formerly East London) on Tuesday morning when she was attacked. Witnesses said the 65-year-old was bitten in two places and died before she was brought to shore. Shark attacks are rare in South Africa, with about 10 fatal ones since 2012, according to the Florida Museum's International Shark Attack File. Lochrenberg was out on a daily morning swim with her local open water swimming club when she was attacked at around 08:00 (06:00 GMT). Fellow swimmers brought her to shore, but it's believed she died before they could get her out of the water. She was bitten on her thigh and her upper arm, one of her fellow swimmers told the BBC. They also said she had been wearing a magnetic shark repellent band on her ankle at the time. Lochrenberg's sister Margot said she was holding her sister's head as they brought her to shore but believed she bled out in the water. She told the BBC that her sister had "loved the water so much" despite knowing there was an "elevated shark presence in East London". "She'd made peace with that. She had a deep affinity with the water and was a remarkable person," she said. Barbara Briceland, Lochrenberg's partner, told the BBC the retired medical physicist was a good swimmer, who often swam far out into the breakers, and described her as very brave. "She was highly intelligent, lots of fun, kind, in a quietish way, thoughtful, well-loved with a love of life." Briceland added they were looking forward to retirement and were about to leave for a three-week road trip together.

articles.title: Sudan army drones hit mourners and fuel market killing more than 300 people, sources say
articles.summary: A truck carrying people to a funeral and a market alleged to be supplying fuel to the RSF were targeted.
articles.body_text: Sudan's army has been accused of launching several drone strikes that have reportedly killed more than 300 people, including dozens travelling to a funeral. The death toll from strikes in two areas of West Kordofan state on Sunday evening was 150, sources told the Sudan War Observatory, which tracks the conflict that erupted in 2023 between the army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF). In Abyei, a disputed border area between Sudan and South Sudan, 153 people were killed when drones hit a market on Monday, the region's information minister said. A military source told the BBC the army had carried out the Abyei attack, saying the market was a fuel supply site for the RSF. The attack has raised tensions between South Sudan and Sudan, which jointly administer Abyei, as they both claim ownership to the oil-rich region in a dispute that has remained unresolved since South Sudan ceded in 2011. South Sudan has summoned Sudan's ambassador to lodge a formal protest. There are fears the conflict could spill across the border. Despite a partial arms embargo on Sudan, foreign countries have been supplying both the army and the RSF with drones and they are increasingly becoming the weapon of choice in the conflict. The war has created one of the worst humanitarian crises in the world, killed hundreds of thousands of people and forced more than 14 million from their homes. "We are alarmed by the continued deadly drone strikes across the country that are killing civilians, including children, and that are disrupting essential services," UN spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday . The rising use of armed drones came as 20 million people faced acute hunger, with a rising risk of famine in parts of the western region of Darfur and Greater Kordofan, he said. Greater Kordofan comprises three states and is a vital axis linking Darfur, controlled by the RSF, to the capital, Khartoum, now in army hands. The wave of drone attacks started on Sunday evening and, according to the Sudan War Observatory, it is likely they were launched from the army-held city of Kadugli in South Kordofan state.

articles.title: Pataz: JEE declara nulas elecciones distritales tras registrar más del 50% de ausentismo
articles.summary: El Jurado Electoral Especial (JEE) de Pataz declaró de oficio la nulidad de las elecciones municipales distritales realizadas en la circunscripción de Pataz. En su resolución de fecha 19 de octubre determinó que acudieron a votar menos del 50% de los electores hábiles.
articles.body_text: El Jurado Electoral Especial (JEE) de Pataz en La Libertad declaró de oficio la nulidad de las elecciones municipales distritales realizadas en la circunscripción de Pataz. En su resolución de fecha 19 de octubre determinó que acudieron a votar menos del 50% de los electores hábiles. La Oficina Descentralizada de Procesos Electorales (ONPE) reportó la asistencia de 3,314 ciudadanos sobre un universo de 6,978 electores habilitados en el padrón electoral. Las cifras oficiales confirmaron un nivel de ausentismo del 52.508% en las 24 mesas de sufragio instaladas durante la jornada democrática. El pleno del JEE se pronunció luego de que declarara improcedente por extemporánea la solicitud de nulidad que interpuso el personero del partido Alianza para el Progreso (APP). El tribunal asumió el caso de oficio al vencer el plazo legal de tres días calendario sin pedidos válidos de las organizaciones políticas. En respuesta, la representación legal de Podemos Perú solicitó proclamar a las autoridades electas bajo la premisa de causales ajenas a la voluntad ciudadana. Los jueces electorales precisaron que el estado de emergencia por la delincuencia en la provincia no restringe ni suspende el derecho al sufragio. En Pataz, a nivel distrital solo compitieron dos listas para la alcaldía: Podemos Perú y Alianza Para el Progreso. El conteo de votos coloca en primer lugar a Podemos Perú. Sin embargo, la resolución especifica de forma categórica que la anulación del proceso abarca de manera exclusiva a la elección municipal del nivel distrital. Las votaciones para la alcaldía provincial y el gobierno regional mantienen su validez porque cada cómputo electoral se resuelve con estricta autonomía. La autoridad fundamentó que otorgar legitimidad a una lista con un ausentismo superior al 50% vulnera el principio de representatividad democrática. El fallo consideró necesario proteger el derecho de participación de la mayoría de votantes que no acudió a las urnas. El artículo 36 de la Ley N° 26864, modificado por la Ley N° 32657, dispone la convocatoria a una única elección complementaria tras la nulidad. El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones activará el procedimiento correspondiente para organizar los nuevos comicios y definir al nuevo alcalde distrital. La norma establece que los resultados de este nuevo proceso serán válidos independientemente del porcentaje de asistencia que se registre en las urnas. Con esto se buscará la proclamación definitiva de las autoridades municipales de Pataz para completar el período de gobierno respectivo.

articles.title: Gorillaz en Lima: concierto se muda a Lurín Live y habrá nuevas entradas desde este jueves
articles.summary: La banda de Damon Albarn se presentará el lunes 23 de noviembre en el kilómetro 32 de la Panamericana Sur. Las entradas compradas siguen siendo válidas y no requieren trámite.
articles.body_text: El concierto de Gorillaz en Lima, el primero de la banda en el país, cambió de sede. La agrupación liderada por Damon Albarn ya no se presentará en Arena 1 Park, sino en Lurín Live, en el kilómetro 32 de la Panamericana Sur, el lunes 23 de noviembre. Según informaron los organizadores en sus redes sociales, la decisión busca garantizar la seguridad y la comodidad de los asistentes. Quienes ya compraron su entrada podrán usarla en el nuevo local sin realizar ningún trámite, pues Ticketmaster actualizará los datos de forma automática. Por la mayor capacidad del recinto, la producción abrirá una nueva venta para todas las zonas a partir de las 10 a. m. del jueves 22 de octubre. Las entradas costarán S/ 463 en Platinum, S/ 342 en VIP y S/ 231 en General, y se podrán adquirir en la web de Ticketmaster y en sus puntos físicos: las tiendas Wong de San Borja, Miraflores y Plaza San Miguel, además del Metro de Plaza Norte. El local dispone de más de 3 mil estacionamientos, que se venderán por los mismos canales a S/ 40. En cuanto al transporte, los organizadores precisaron que varias líneas de transporte urbano llegan hasta Lurín Live. Las rutas 1254 y 1251 recorren distritos del centro y el sur de la capital; las líneas 1098 y 1058 conectan con el Cono Este, y la 1488 parte desde Chosica y zonas aledañas. Al finalizar el concierto, se dispondrá de buses de gran capacidad hacia Lima, con un pasaje de S/ 12 y tres paraderos finales: Puente Benavides y Trébol de Javier Prado, en Surco, y Puente Santa Anita, en la Vía de Evitamiento y la Carretera Central.

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.body_text: León XIV, operado la pasada semana de un tumor canceroso en el pulmón, sigue su recuperación en el Palacio Apostólico vaticano y el próximo miércoles volverá a celebrar la habitual Audiencia General en la Plaza de San Pedro, informaron fuentes de la oficina de prensa de la Santa Sede. El pontífice permanecerá en El Vaticano, según las citadas fuentes, y no se desplazará esta semana a la localidad de Castelgandolfo -a unos 30 kilómetros de Roma- como solía hacer antes de su operación para descansar la tarde del lunes y el martes. El papa estadounidense-peruano, de 71 años, fue intervenido el pasado 13 de octubre en el hospital Gemelli de Roma por un adenocarcinoma (un tipo de cáncer) en una cirugía en la que le extirparon el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho. El sábado recibió el alta hospitalaria tras una favorable recuperación y regresó al Vaticano, donde el domingo volvió a presidir el rezo del ángelus.El propio León XIV explicó públicamente tras la plegaria que, una vez superada la “delicada” etapa de la operación, retomará gradualmente sus actividades. Además de la audiencia general del miércoles, para esta semana se prevé que León XIV reciba el jueves o viernes a los participantes del Congreso Internacional sobre la Pastoral Escolar y Universitaria que, con el lema “Trazando nuevos caminos de esperanza”, se celebrará los días 22 y 23 de octubre en el Aula Pablo VI del Vaticano.

articles.title: Turismo en las playas del norte pierde impulso: ¿cómo amenaza El Niño la temporada de verano?
articles.summary: Pese al crecimiento de los arribos a hospedajes durante el 2026, la incertidumbre por el fenómeno climático ha reducido entre 5% y 8% las nuevas reservas, mientras que en Tumbes las cancelaciones se acercan al 30%, según representantes del sector. Las empresas apuestan por promociones y garantías para recuperar la confianza de los viajeros.
articles.body_text: El 2026 apuntaba a ser un año de recuperación para el turismo en el norte peruano, como lo demostraban las cifras del Ministerio de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur). Entre enero y agosto, el número de arribos de visitantes nacionales y extranjeros a establecimientos de hospedaje creció a doble dígito en Piura (10%), Lambayeque (15%), La Libertad (15%) y Tumbes (42%), en comparación con el mismo periodo del 2025, con un comportamiento mixto entre el turismo interno y el receptivo. Incluso, la visita del Papa León XIV, prevista para noviembre, elevó las proyecciones y llevó a regiones como Lambayeque a prepararse para recibir a más de un millón de visitantes. Estas expectativas representaban una buena noticia tras un 2025 retador. “El 2025 comenzó el año con oleajes anómalos que afectaron tremendamente la imagen de las playas del norte; por otro lado, hubo un incremento en los pasajes aéreos. Algunas aerolíneas dejaron de volar y había menos frecuencias a algunos destinos de playas del norte, y eso encareció los pasajes. Todo eso hizo que el año no sea tan bueno, pero todo lo contrario ha sucedido este año. Este ha sido un año récord en cuanto a ventas”, asegura Juan Stoessel, director de ComexPerú y CEO de Casa Andina. Sin embargo, la incertidumbre sobre los efectos del fenómeno de El Niño (FEN) ha comenzado a frenar el ritmo de nuevas reservas hoteleras en las playas del norte peruano, pese a que las condiciones del mar son favorables para la temporada de verano, según Stoessel. “Hemos visto una reducción de entre el 5% y el 8% en cuanto al volumen de nuevas reservas después de octubre, porque las noticias que están dando no son claras. El norte actualmente está en perfectas condiciones para los bañistas, con una temperatura de mar maravillosa y sin vientos. Además, la conectividad no ha sufrido interferencias”, refiere. En Tumbes, las temperaturas ya son similares a las del verano y las lluvias se concentran en las zonas altas, cerca de la frontera con Ecuador, sin alcanzar la costa, donde se ubica el 95% de los hoteles. Así lo explica Carlos Viñas, presidente de la Cámara Regional de Turismo (Caretur). No obstante, la corriente de El Niño está acelerando el proceso de desarenado, lo que afecta a los hoteles construidos sin respetar los niveles de marea alta, sobre todo en Zorritos, Acapulco y algunas zonas de Cancas. Más allá de estas condiciones, el temor de los turistas se ha convertido en otro factor que afecta las reservas, comenta Viñas. Según explica, las noticias constantes sobre la intensidad del fenómeno han generado preocupación entre los viajeros y provocado la cancelación de cerca del 30% de las reservas. “Se ha creado un temor para viajar a las playas del norte. Ese temor es infundado porque no hay afectación por el fenómeno. Los hoteles están en buen estado, en algunas zonas falta arena en la playa, pero las instalaciones son óptimas”, agrega. A este panorama se suma un cambio en las decisiones de los principales visitantes de estos destinos. Los limeños están aprovechando el aumento de las temperaturas en la capital para disfrutar de las playas del sur, mientras que los ecuatorianos están dejando de visitar Tumbes debido al incremento de la delincuencia en su país, que los lleva a permanecer en casa para evitar robos en sus domicilios. La Asociación Peruana de Agencias de Viajes y Turismo (Apavit) coincide con este diagnóstico, aunque su presidenta, Patricia Campos, aclara que la situación varía según el destino. En muchos casos, señala, los turistas retoman sus planes de viaje tras informarse sobre las condiciones reales del lugar que visitarán. Aun así, el sector mantiene la preocupación por el impacto que podrían tener las lluvias en los próximos meses. A inicios de año, la Asociación Peruana de Operadores de Turismo Receptivo e Interno (Apotur) estimó que la macrorregión norte podría registrar afectaciones de entre 1.500 y 2.000 paquetes turísticos debido a cancelaciones o postergaciones vinculadas a las lluvias y los riesgos asociados al FEN. “Bajo este supuesto, las afectaciones reportadas representarían alrededor de 4.500 a 6.000 turistas. Esta cifra podría elevarse en el verano del 2027 de repetirse sucesos como el ocurrido en febrero de 2026, cuando las lluvias y los cortes de la Panamericana Norte provocaron que establecimientos hoteleros en Máncora registraran cancelaciones de hasta el 70% de sus reservas”, opinó Gabriela Fiorini, presidenta del Gremio Turismo de la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL). La incertidumbre sobre las reservas hoteleras contrasta con la demanda de vuelos al norte, que se mantiene elevada. En las últimas semanas, la ocupabilidad de aerolíneas como JetSmart alcanzó el 90% en rutas hacia destinos como Chiclayo y Piura. Sin embargo, todavía es difícil anticipar cómo evolucionará la demanda en los próximos meses. “Como en el mercado doméstico la mayoría de viajeros compra con poca anticipación, todavía no podemos proyectar cómo se comportarán las reservas de noviembre y diciembre”, aclara Francesca Luna, Country Manager de JetSmart Perú. En contraste con la incertidumbre que enfrenta el norte, los aeropuertos del sur operados por Aeropuertos Andinos del Perú (AAP) mantienen expectativas positivas para el primer trimestre del próximo año, periodo en el que se prevé una mayor incidencia de los efectos del FEN. “Para el primer trimestre del 2027, mantenemos estimaciones positivas e incluso un aumento en el tránsito de pasajeros en las regiones donde operamos. En ese sentido, Juliaca y Puerto Maldonado serían las regiones que liderarían el crecimiento en el flujo de pasajeros, seguidas por Ayacucho, Arequipa y Tacna. Para el cierre de este año, prevemos superar los 4,7 millones de pasajeros en los cinco aeropuertos que gestionamos, 100.000 más que el año pasado”, informó la empresa a Día1. El verano concentra el 35% de las ventas anuales de los negocios ubicados en las playas del norte. La temporada comienza en enero y puede extenderse hasta Semana Santa, aunque octubre también es un mes importante por el avistamiento de ballenas, mientras que diciembre destaca por las festividades de fin de año. Ante este escenario, implementar estrategias para atraer visitantes resulta crucial para los negocios turísticos. Stoessel indica que todos los hoteles, incluido Casa Andina, se han comprometido a reembolsar el monto de las reservas si la temporada de lluvias se adelanta y afecta las vacaciones de sus clientes. Por su parte, Fiorini, de la CCL, destaca que, si bien los negocios ofrecen promociones propias de la temporada, la transparencia en la información que reciben los turistas es fundamental para impulsar las decisiones de viaje. “Frente a la incertidumbre por las lluvias, el precio no es el único factor que determina la decisión de viajar. Los turistas requieren información clara sobre el estado de las carreteras y el funcionamiento de los servicios. Por eso, es importante que los negocios combinen sus campañas comerciales con información actualizada que genere confianza en el visitante”, refirió.

articles.body_text: El precio del dólar cerró este martes 20 de octubre en S/3,427, por debajo de los S/3,437 de la jornada anterior, con una apreciación del sol peruano de aproximadamente 0,27%. La caída estuvo acompañada por el debilitamiento de la moneda estadounidense a nivel internacional y la moderación de los precios del petróleo, ante las expectativas de avances diplomáticos entre Estados Unidos e Irán. “El Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) retrocedió 0,26%, hasta los 101.708 puntos, mientras los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense a 10 y 30 años descendieron a 5,119% y 5,431%, respectivamente. La debilidad de algunos indicadores de empleo y construcción en Estados Unidos también presionó al dólar”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, el petróleo WTI retrocedió 0,88%, hasta US$97,67 por barril, ante las expectativas de una posible reanudación del diálogo entre Washington y Teherán. Por su parte, el oro cayó 0,37%, mientras la plata avanzó 1,35% y el cobre 0,48%. En América Latina, el real brasileño se apreció 0,81% y el peso mexicano 0.09%, favorecidos por la debilidad del dólar. En el mercado local, el tipo de cambio fluctuó entre S/3,425 y S/3,435, con un volumen negociado de US$288,6 millones. La cotización inició la jornada en S/3,435 y continuó retrocediendo ante los flujos netos de oferta de dólares provenientes de agentes offshore y empresas corporativas. De acuerdo con Huayta, la caída del dólar global y de los rendimientos de los bonos estadounidenses contribuyó a reducir la presión externa sobre el sol. A ello se sumó la oferta de divisas en el mercado local, que llevó al tipo de cambio hacia niveles inferiores durante la sesión. Allisson Pérez, trader de Divisas en Renta4 SAB, agregó que el dólar encuentra soporte en el repunte de los rendimientos de corto plazo de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense, elevando el atractivo de los activos en dólares. Para el mercado peruano, este escenario podría generar presiones alcistas sobre el USD/PEN si se fortalece la demanda de dólares; sin embargo, la evolución del sol dependerá también de los flujos locales.

articles.summary: El presidente de Ucrania, Volodymyr Zelensky, propuso este miércoles “congelar” el frente en la guerra de su país con Rusia como un primer paso para iniciar conversaciones de un cese el fuego.
articles.body_text: El presidente de Ucrania, Volodymyr Zelensky, propuso este miércoles “congelar” el frente en la guerra de su país con Rusia como un primer paso para iniciar conversaciones de un cese el fuego. “En este momento tenemos que congelar, y pienso que es esa la manera de terminar esta guerra. Lo llamamos cese el fuego... congelar y parar”, dijo Zelensky en entrevista con Fox News, al ser preguntado sobre si aceptaría un acuerdo de paz que deje el frente en las líneas actuales tras la invasión rusa. Zelensky hizo estas declaraciones mientras el enviado estadounidense Steve Witkoff se reunía en Rusia con el presidente Vladimir Putin para conversar sobre la guerra en Ucrania. Cuando Witkoff aterrizó en San Petersburgo, Rusia anunció que pronto comenzaría a enviar cargamentos de diésel a Estados Unidos en virtud de un acuerdo con el presidente Donald Trump, y que había liberado a un ciudadano estadounidense detenido por Moscú desde el inicio de la guerra. Zelensky insistió en que cualquier negociación de paz debe incluir a Ucrania. “Siempre he dicho que estamos abiertos a negociar en cualquier formato, sobre cualquier tema. Pero no hablen de nosotros sin nosotros, por favor”, enfatizó. El mandatario ucraniano también subrayó que cualquier acuerdo de paz debe incluir garantías de seguridad de socios como Estados Unidos y aliados europeos. Esto permitiría a los ucranianos no tener “temor (...) de que la ocupación vuelva, de que la agresión vuelva, de que los asesinatos vuelvan”, apuntó. Zelensky también se refirió a los sistemas de comunicaciones operados por la empresa estadounidense SpaceX: Starshield, crucial para sus comunicaciones en el campo de batalla, y Starlink, el sistema de satélites civiles. Los servicios de Starlink y Starshield “siguen limitados”, dijo, luego de que Kiev acusara días atrás a Washington de reducir deliberadamente las velocidades de Starshield. “Pero el secretario (de Estado estadounidense Marco Rubio) me dijo que trabajará con su equipo en esto para desbloquearlo”, añadió Zelensky. The Wall Street Journal informó el martes de que el propietario de SpaceX, Elon Musk, había ordenado la reducción de los servicios de Starshield. El magnate tecnológico había dicho anteriormente que cualquier límite en el sistema habría procedido de Trump, una acusación que el presidente estadounidense negó.

Los niveles de El Niño podrían situarse “hasta el punto de situarse literalmente fuera de las escalas de seguimiento que hemos utilizado durante las últimas cuatro décadas”, admitió en rueda de prensa la secretaria general de la Organización Meteorológica Mundial (OMM), la argentina Celeste Saulo. Ella y el coordinador humanitario de Naciones Unidas, Tom Fletcher, hicieron un llamamiento de emergencia para que el mundo se prepare ante un El Niño que puede causar graves sequías, lluvias torrenciales e inundaciones en determinadas regiones del planeta. “Sacudirá América Latina, África oriental y austral, Asia y el Pacífico con calor extremo, sequías e inundaciones”, subrayó Fletcher, quien advirtió que los efectos podrían provocar que aumente la inseguridad alimentaria de 50 millones de personas. El coordinador humanitario anunció que su oficina ha decidido destinar 50 millones de dólares de su fondo de emergencias para asistir a 11 de los países que podrían verse más afectados, incluidos Chad, El Salvador, Etiopía, Somalia y Sudán del Sur. “Ya estamos presenciando fenómenos meteorológicos extremos y esperamos que éstos se multipliquen y desencadenen otros a medida que El Niño se intensifique”, agregó Saulo, quien subrayó que ello “no tiene que desencadenar a la fuerza un desastre humanitario”. “En muchas regiones aún estamos a tiempo de prepararnos”, añadió, insistiendo en que las condiciones meteorológicas extremas “no tienen por qué traducirse en emergencias humanitarias ni en víctimas mortales”, aunque advirtió que la ventana de oportunidad “no permanecerá abierta definitivamente”.

articles.title: Piura lidera los contagios de dengue en el Perú con más de 13 mil casos y 9 fallecidos
articles.summary: La Dirección Regional de Salud y el Centro Nacional de Epidemiología, Prevención y Control de Enfermedades informaron que la región de Piura encabeza la lista de contagios por dengue en el país con 13,025 infectados. Las entidades oficiales reportan además 9 fallecidos por la enfermedad en el departamento norteño.
articles.body_text: La Dirección Regional de Salud y el Centro Nacional de Epidemiología, Prevención y Control de Enfermedades informaron que la región de Piura encabeza la lista de contagios por dengue en el país con 13,025 infectados. Las entidades oficiales reportan además 9 fallecidos por la enfermedad en el departamento norteño. La Sala Situacional de la Diresa precisó que el 68% de los casos notificados contó con la debida confirmación de laboratorio. El reporte sanitario detalló la presencia del serotipo 3 del virus y advirtió sobre cuadros graves con necesidad de hospitalización en la zona. A nivel provincial, Piura acumula la cifra más alta de la región con 5,453 contagiados en sus diferentes distritos. Las provincias de Morropón y Sullana siguieron en la estadística oficial con 3,810 y 3,016 personas afectadas respectivamente. Los adultos de 30 a 59 años representan el 30,2% de los infectados en la región. Los niños de 0 a 11 años concentraron 3,414 infectados y cinco de los decesos registrados por las autoridades médicas. El Ministerio de Salud inició la aplicación de la vacuna Qdenga para personas entre los 10 y 20 años de edad para frenar el avance del dengue. La cobertura de la inmunización alcanza un 34,8% en la primera dosis y un 58% en la segunda aplicación dentro de los grupos prioritarios. El CDC del Minsa notificó 71,256 casos y 75 muertes por la epidemia a nivel nacional. En Lima se concentran aproximadamente unos 6,000 casos confirmados, mientras que se registran solo en Piura unos 1,000 contagios por semana desde hace varios días. El director general del Centro Nacional de Epidemiología, Prevención y Control de Enfermedades (CDC), César Munayco, informó a Canal N que las otras regiones que le siguen a Piura en número de contagios son La Libertad y Lambayeque. En esa línea, advirtió que las cifras seguirán incrementando si el calor y las lluvias persisten en la zona norte del país. Desde este lunes 19 de octubre se registran intensas lluvias que han inundados las calles y viviendas de Chulucanas en la provincia de Morropón, entre otros sectores vulnerables de Piura. El agua acumulada sobrepasó los 30 centímetros de altura en los mercados locales y provocó el colapso del sistema de alcantarillado. El fenómeno El Niño Costero originó lluvias continuas y elevadas temperaturas durante varios días consecutivos en la región. La acumulación de agua en recipientes inservibles multiplica los criaderos del mosquito Aedes aegypti y eleva el riesgo de nuevos contagios. La emergencia está siendo atendida con el despliegue de motobombas para disminuir el nivel del agua en las calles inundadas. Asimismo, se cuenta con el apoyo de miembros de las Fuerzas Armadas y la vigilancia de personal de la Defensoría del Pueblo para constatar la situación.

El pontífice permanecerá en El Vaticano, según las citadas fuentes, y no se desplazará esta semana a la localidad de Castelgandolfo -a unos 30 kilómetros de Roma- como solía hacer antes de su operación para descansar la tarde del lunes y el martes. El papa estadounidense-peruano, de 71 años, fue intervenido el pasado 13 de octubre en el hospital Gemelli de Roma por un adenocarcinoma (un tipo de cáncer) en una cirugía en la que le extirparon el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho. El sábado recibió el alta hospitalaria tras una favorable recuperación y regresó al Vaticano, donde el domingo volvió a presidir el rezo del ángelus.El propio León XIV explicó públicamente tras la plegaria que, una vez superada la “delicada” etapa de la operación, retomará gradualmente sus actividades. Además de la audiencia general del miércoles, para esta semana se prevé que León XIV reciba el jueves o viernes a los participantes del Congreso Internacional sobre la Pastoral Escolar y Universitaria que, con el lema “Trazando nuevos caminos de esperanza”, se celebrará los días 22 y 23 de octubre en el Aula Pablo VI del Vaticano.

articles.title: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company's acquisition | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.
articles.body_text: Last month, advertising company Infillion acquired location-data platform Foursquare, a once popular social network, at an undisclosed value. Now, in a new blog post , Foursquare co-founder and former CEO Dennis Crowley said that investors didn’t see any returns from the sale. Crowley referenced a post by an angel investor , inferred that neither preferred nor common stockholders got any value out of the deal, and said he was disappointed by the outcome. “I was heartbroken by this ending. So many people put so much time and energy and passion and love into building Foursquare – the company, the products, the brand, the culture. If you were part of it (or even close to it), you know exactly what I’m talking about. To our ~1600 former employees over 17 years, I am sorry the Foursquare story ended in such a way that makes it seem like our collective efforts were worth… nothing?,” he said in the post. Crowley said that the company did well after it started focusing on enterprise business and had consecutive years with over $100 million in revenue. In 2019, the company raised capital from a private equity firm and, in 2021, brought in the banker who led the raise as CEO. Crowley blamed the final outcome on that transition, saying that the management of the company wasn’t able to preserve or create new value. Foursquare, which had raised over $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, eventually shut down its app in 2024 . Several people reacted to Crowley’s post and said that Foursquare was very useful to them in discovering new places in their cities and also gave ideas for new apps . articles.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it's mostly a headache for now | TechCrunch
articles.summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.
articles.body_text: Companies are giving employees AI tools to make them more productive, but the tools appear to be creating new problems for their managers. More than half of senior leaders say they find it harder to evaluate employees’ work after adopting AI, according to a Nielsen survey of 1,700 directors and senior managers across seven countries, commissioned by work-management company Monday.com. The reason is that much of employees’ output now arrives polished in the manager’s inbox, making it hard to tell how much came from the employee and how much from AI. As a result, nearly half of managers say they spend more time reviewing and guiding their teams’ output than they used to. That’s not to say managers are unhappy about AI. Quite the opposite, in fact: 94% of the managers polled said they were excited to improve work using AI, and many are confident they know where to use it to get the most value. Michal Miller Levi, head of market research and customer insights at Monday.com, compared the enthusiasm to the early days of the internet in the 2000s, saying people see a similar kind of “magic” to AI. But the problem, she told TechCrunch, is simply that AI is developing faster than companies can adapt. “AI works very well for [managers] individually, but they also have a different role as managers. They need to drive the organization as well […] Their struggle is [due to] the fact that AI is just moving faster than the organizational processes,” Levi said. Managers are also reconsidering how they judge their teams: 78% of respondents said they have changed how they evaluate employees after adopting AI, placing greater weight on how well staff can create prompts, decide which tasks to delegate to AI, and experiment with new ways of working. But how fairly can employees be judged when managers can’t easily tell how much of their work was produced by AI? And what if the managers themselves are increasingly relying on AI to make those judgments? The survey found that 46% of managers use AI to help inform their decisions, and 39% of leaders are using AI to draft performance reviews. That practice runs the risk of introducing even more bias than usual into the review process, given that LLMs are, at their core, prediction machines, and tend to repeat human patterns found in their training data. Research from the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research earlier this year found that “in the absence of clear objective standards and when individuals are rated independently,” LLMs tend to rate performance similarly to humans. And a research paper in early 2025 found that AI models can be biased against black male candidates, and “demonstrate significant biases, varying in terms of the directions and magnitudes across different social groups.” When I asked Levi whether using AI to weigh in on people’s performance could introduce outside bias into the process, she said companies have yet to work out how to handle such issues. AI is also changing what a manager’s day looks like. Someone has to decide which tasks to hand over to AI agents, check what they produce, and step in when something goes wrong. The report suggests that this supervision could amount to a new layer of “invisible labor.” The software itself is becoming harder to manage. Fifty-seven percent of managers say their organizations now have more tools in circulation than before, and about 51% said their tools had grown more interdependent and clustered since adopting AI. Only 29% described their AI infrastructure as fully optimized and centralized. Levi said businesses had expected AI to help shrink their software stacks. Instead, they’re dealing with more apps, integrations, and shadow AI usage as employees adopt tools outside their companies’ approved systems. “Managers completed 2025 with the feeling that they will consolidate tools, actually; that they’ll reduce the number of software. But what happened is that the number of tools that they’re using increased,” Levi said. “More than 50% are saying that they’re using more tools now than they did last year, and it’s not stopping […].”

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Elon Musk likes the idea but says he is not on either committee, which is made up of independent directors.
articles.body_text: The boards of SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees to review a possible merger. The special committees, which consist of independent directors, were created at the request of shareholders, according to Elon Musk, CEO and the largest individual shareholder of both companies. “Because I’m a conflicted party, I can’t actually be in the discussions of the special committees, so it’s this sort of a … It’s an odd kabuki dance where two groups of people are talking, and I can’t be in the conversation,” Musk said in response to a question during SpaceX’s third-quarter earnings call. Musk didn’t name the members of these special committees, only noting that they were independent directors. Tesla has seven independent board members under Nasdaq’s listing standards, including board chair Robyn Denholm; Ira Ehrenpreis, who is also a committee chair; former Tesla CTO JB Straubel; Joe Gebbia; Jack Hartung; James Murdoch; and Kathleen Wilson-Thompson, according to the company’s October 19 proxy filing . Neither Musk nor his brother Kimbal Musk is independent. Denholm, Gebbia, Ehrenpreis, Hartung, Murdoch, and Wilson-Thompson sit on a variety of established committees overseeing audit, compensation, and corporate governance. SpaceX lists six independent directors , including Ehrenpreis, who is also the chair of the company’s compensation and nominating committee. Randy Glein, Donald Harrison, Steve Jurvetson, Luke Nosek, and Roelof Botha are also considered independent directors. Antonio Gracias, Musk, and SpaceX president and chief operating officer Gwynne Shotwell are also on the board, but not considered independent. Gracias, who once sat on Tesla’s board, founded and leads Valor Equity Partners, which has a 3.4% stake in SpaceX. Gracias’ firm also financed SpaceX’s AI hardware purchases through leaseback arrangements. Musk said he supports the idea of the merger but cautioned that it is not a guaranteed outcome. “I think some people out there assume that a SpaceX and Tesla Motor is a certainty, and I think that would be overstating it,” he said, adding that he thinks it would be a good idea. “At the end of the day, the shareholders have to be supportive of this.” The special committees have not reached agreement on the terms of any transactions, he said. The SpaceX IPO cemented Musk’s grip on the company — he has more than 50% voting power — which would make it easier to garner support for a merger from SpaceX shareholders. It is a much bigger hurdle over at Tesla, where the company would need a 50% vote from all shareholders, not just those who vote, Musk noted. “I do think there’s a lot of merit to combining the companies as we are pretty much in the superintelligence singularity,” Musk said, adding there was a lot to be gaining from cooperating on developing AI software, robotics, SpaceX’s orbital AI data center project Starmind, and Terafab, the joint chip manufacturing project between Tesla and SpaceX.
